title: Navvi records
description: One item per record: the requested fields (typed when a type was declared: money, number and integer as numbers, boolean as true/false, url as an absolute link; null when a value does not coerce), plus _source, the page it came from, and _startUrl, the start URL that produced it. Run-level accounting (dead, transient, blocked, unsettled and no-payload pages, empty listings, off-template URLs, optional drift, injection flags) is in the SUMMARY record of the run's key-value store, not in the dataset.

_source.description: The URL of the page the record was extracted from (a listing's later page, or where a redirect landed).

_startUrl.description: The start URL that produced the record: the listing requested before pagination or redirect. Equals _source on a record-mode row.

overview.title: Records
overview.description: The extracted records with their source page and start URL. Your requested fields are in the All fields tab.

example.title: Example run (Hacker News)
example.description: The fields of the prefilled example run: the Hacker News front page, list mode, typed fields. Empty columns on a run that asked for other fields.
